On the PC, open the 3dssavesync settings, go to Server and click \"Show the QR code\". Or type the address and token.

Before it replaces a save, the app keeps a copy of it here, one folder per emulator. Connect the phone to a computer over USB to see them (Android/data folder). Uninstalling the app deletes these copies: to update the app, install the new APK over the old one.
3dssavesync keeps your game saves the same on this phone, your 3DS and your PC. Three short steps set it up: your server, your emulator, its folders.
Which emulator do you play with? You can add others later in Emulators.
Your games are in the Games tab. Pull the list down to read it again.
Connect to your server in Settings when you want: the games then show their state.
No emulator yet. Add the emulators you play with, then choose their folders.
The app only opens the folders you choose. It never deletes your files.
The app forgets this emulator and its folders. No file is deleted: your saves and the backup copies stay where they are.
Rename it if you have two entries of the same emulator: the lists then tell them apart.
Azahar user folder (the one that contains sdmc)
Folder not found. If it\'s on an SD card, insert the card; else choose the folder again.

Game Boy and Game Boy Color

Choose the ROM folder of each system. If RetroArch keeps its saves in RetroArch/saves (the default), also choose that folder once: the app finds the folder of each core in it. Play Store version: in the folder picker, open the menu and choose RetroArch. Close RetroArch before you sync.
Choose the user folder you chose in Azahar at its first start (it contains the sdmc folder). Only the 8 Pokémon games of the 3DS are synced. Close Azahar before you sync.
melonDS saves next to the ROM by default: choose the ROM folder. If you set another save folder in melonDS, untick \"Saves next to the ROMs\" and choose that folder.
DraStic keeps its saves in DraStic/backup (.dsv files). Choose the ROM folder, then that backup folder. Close DraStic before you sync.
NooDS saves next to the ROM by default: choose the ROM folder. Keep that setting: its other save folder is closed to other apps.

Pizza Boy keeps its saves in its private folder (Android/data/it.dbtecno.pizzaboy…), and Android 11 and later close that folder to other apps. If your version of Pizza Boy lets you choose its save folder, choose a folder outside Android/data there, then choose the same folder here.

Choose the folder where the emulator writes its saves, and type their extension (.sav, .dsv). This emulator is not checked: before your first sync, copy its save folder to another place with a file manager.

resources.string:
The server version will replace these saves on this phone. A backup copy of each one is made first.

%1$s

Close your emulators before you continue.
Conflicts, waiting for your choice: %1$s. Open each game to choose which save to keep.
Not replaced: %1$s. You didn\'t confirm the replacement of their save on this phone. Open each game to check it.
The sync stopped at the first error, so the next games were not tried. Fix the problem below, then tap Sync all again.
The save on this phone is newer. Tap Upload to send it to the server.
The server has a newer save. Tap Download to get it: the app first keeps a backup copy of the save on this phone.
The save changed on this phone and on the server since the last sync. Choose which one to keep.
This save came back to the version that was replaced: the emulator was probably still open.
The last write of this save on this phone didn\'t finish: the app was stopped during the write. The file may be incomplete, so don\'t play this game yet. Choose the server save or the backup copy.
This phone and the server have the same save.
%1$d ROMs hold this game, so it isn\'t synced. If one of them is a ROM hack, give it its own save. Else keep only one of them in the ROM folder.
%1$d ROMs would use the same save file, so they aren\'t synced. Rename one of them.
The app couldn\'t read the server or this save, so the state is unknown. Pull the list down to read it again.
No save on this phone or on the server yet. Play and save in the game, then refresh.
A ROM hack often keeps the code of its original game, so the app could mix them up. Add the hack ROM here to give it its own save.
The save key comes from the ROM file name, as on the PC. To sync the hack with the PC and the 3DS, add the same ROM file in the PC settings (ROM hacks), then prepare the 3DS SD card again.
The app then reads %1$s as its original game again. No save is deleted.
Give this ROM its own save
%1$s: its ROM hack key (%2$s) isn\'t valid, so it isn\'t synced. Remove it in Settings, ROM hacks, then add the ROM again.
This ROM can\'t get its own save.
Never started in Azahar: Download creates its save folder
Play time %1$d h %2$02d · not started yet
The server version will replace the save on this phone. A backup copy is made first. Close the emulator before you continue.
Replace the save on this phone?
Which save do you want to keep?
The save on this phone will be uploaded. The server keeps its current version in its History.
The server save will replace the one on this phone. A backup copy of the phone save is made first. Close the emulator before you continue.
Nothing is lost: the server keeps every version in its History, and this phone keeps a backup copy before any replacement.
Downloaded. The previous save is in the backup copies.
The server changed meanwhile: compare the two saves again, then choose.
Nothing was replaced: the state changed meanwhile. Check it, then try again.
The backup copy made before the interrupted write will replace the file on this phone. A backup copy of the file as it is now is made first. Close the emulator before you continue.
The backup copy is back in place.
The server rejected this token. Scan the PC\'s QR code again, or copy the exact token into Settings.
This address isn\'t a 3dssavesync server. Check it in the settings.
Save too large for the server. Raise the size limit on the server or its proxy.
The server rejected this save (empty, too large or cut off). Try again.
The server ran into an error. Try again later. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
The server sent an unexpected response. Check its address in Settings: it may need https://.
The server\'s certificate isn\'t valid. Check the address (https://) and the date of the phone.
Can\'t find the server. Check the Wi-Fi connection and the server address.
The server refused the connection. Check that it\'s running and that the address and port are right.
The server isn\'t responding. Check the Wi-Fi connection and the server address.
The save from the server arrived incomplete, so yours wasn\'t replaced. Try again.
Another device is uploading this save at the same time. Try again in a moment.
The backup copy couldn\'t be made, so nothing was replaced. Check the free space on the phone.
The new save couldn\'t be written correctly, so the previous one was put back. Check the folder in Emulators, then try again.
The save couldn\'t be written, and the previous one couldn\'t be put back. Don\'t play this game: copy the backup copy named below back into the save folder.

The new save couldn\'t be written. This phone had no save for this game, so nothing was lost. If a save file of this game is now in the folder, delete it before you play. Then check the folder in Emulators and try again.

The save couldn\'t be written, and the app couldn\'t remove the folder it created for this game in Azahar. Azahar would see a broken save: before you start this game, delete the folder named below with a file manager. Then try again.
This game was never started in Azahar, but its folder already holds a 00000001.metadata file, so the app doesn\'t create its save. Start the game once in Azahar, save in the game, then refresh.
The save on this phone changed during the sync, so it wasn\'t replaced. Close the emulator, then try again.
This save file has an unexpected format, so it wasn\'t synced. Check the emulator and its core in Emulators.
The app can no longer open this folder or file. Choose the folder again in Emulators.
The backup copy is no longer in the app\'s folder. Use the server save instead.
Something went wrong. Try again. If it happens again, report the detail below.
This save changed a few seconds ago, so the emulator may still be open. Swipe it away from the recent apps, then try again.
Close the emulator first: swipe it away from the recent apps. An emulator left open writes its old save back over the new one.
The versions of this game on the server, newest first. Tap one to see it.
The app couldn\'t read the history.
No version of this game on the server.
The version the devices download. Choose an older one to restore it.
Same content as the current version: nothing to restore.
Restore makes it the current version on the server again. Then the app offers to download it to this phone, after a backup copy.

It becomes the current version on the server again. Nothing is deleted: the current one stays in the history. Then the app offers to download it to this phone, after a backup copy of its save. Sync your other devices first: a game not uploaded yet could replace this version or cause a conflict.
This version is no longer on the server. Choose another one.
The version from the server arrived damaged. Try again.
The save just changed on the server: a device uploaded it meanwhile. The list is up to date again: choose again.
About every 15 minutes, the app uploads the saves you played on this phone. It never downloads and never replaces a save here: open the app and tap Sync all for that.
Notifications are off: the problems show only here.
%1$s: conflict. Open the game to choose which save to keep.
